generic.Defined scope/population: All manual journal entries posted in BlackLine this period above the materiality threshold

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if all sampled entries show a distinct, timestamped approver, else fail
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected entries route back to the preparer in BlackLine for correction and resubmission
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Entry is approved only when support, rationale, and segregation of duties are confirmed
generic.Evidence location: Approval signature and timestamp stored on the JE record in SAP S/4HANA and linked in BlackLine

steps.title: Open the BlackLine JE approval queue and filter above-threshold entries
sop: 1) Log into BlackLine and open the JE approval queue for the period.
2) Filter the queue by amount to isolate entries above the materiality threshold.
Done when the above-threshold entry list is displayed and counted.
verify: 1) Confirm the filtered count matches the expected above-threshold population.
Pass when every above-threshold entry appears in the filtered queue.

steps.title: Review each entry's attached support in BlackLine
sop: 1) Open each queued entry and inspect the attached support document.
2) Confirm the support and rationale tie to the posted amount and account.
Done when every entry's support is confirmed present and relevant.
verify: 1) Spot-check three entries for support-to-amount agreement.
Pass when all reviewed entries show matching, relevant support.

steps.title: Confirm preparer/approver segregation against the JE authority matrix
sop: 1) Pull the preparer field for each queued entry from SAP S/4HANA.
2) Compare preparer identity to the proposed approver per the authority matrix.
Done when every entry shows a preparer distinct from its approver.
verify: 1) Check the authority matrix against each preparer/approver pair.
Pass when no entry shows the preparer and approver as the same person.

steps.title: Approve each qualifying entry in SAP S/4HANA
sop: 1) Open each entry that passed support and segregation checks.
2) Apply electronic signature approval with the system timestamp.
Done when every qualifying entry carries a signed, timestamped approval.
verify: 1) Confirm the approval signature and timestamp are recorded.
Pass when all qualifying entries show a signed, timestamped approval.

steps.title: Reject and return unsupported entries to the preparer
sop: 1) Identify entries lacking support, rationale, or segregation.
2) Reject each entry in BlackLine with a documented return reason.
Done when every deficient entry is rejected and routed back to its preparer.
verify: 1) Confirm each rejected entry shows a logged return reason.
Pass when no deficient entry remains approved or unaddressed.

steps.title: Confirm the approval queue shows zero pending entries
sop: 1) Refresh the BlackLine JE approval queue after all actions post.
2) Confirm no above-threshold entry remains pending.
Done when the queue shows zero pending above-threshold entries.
verify: 1) Re-run the queue filter to confirm nothing remains pending.
Pass when the queue is empty of pending above-threshold entries.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation is complete only when the matching control clears with no exceptions

steps.title: Run the automated three-way match control in BlackLine
sop: 1) Open the three-way matching control in BlackLine.
2) Run the match comparing JE, support document, and approval record.
Done when the match control run completes for the period.
verify: 1) Confirm the run log shows a completed status.
Pass when the run completes without a system error.

steps.title: Review entries flagged as exceptions by the matching control
sop: 1) Open the exception list generated by the matching control.
2) Review each flagged entry for the cause of the mismatch.
Done when every flagged entry has an identified cause.
verify: 1) Spot-check the identified cause against the entry detail.
Pass when each flagged entry's cause is correctly identified.

steps.title: Resolve mismatches by correcting entries or obtaining support
sop: 1) Correct the entry or obtain the missing support/approval.
2) Update the entry status once resolved.
Done when every flagged entry is corrected or supported.
verify: 1) Re-run the match control on resolved entries.
Pass when resolved entries clear the matching control.

steps.title: Confirm the matching control clears with zero exceptions
sop: 1) Re-run the three-way match control after resolutions.
2) Confirm the exception count is zero.
Done when the control run shows zero unresolved exceptions.
verify: 1) Review the final run output for exception count.
Pass when zero unresolved exceptions remain.

steps.title: Attach the match control results to the close task
sop: 1) Compile the final matching control run results.
2) Attach the results to the BlackLine close task.
Done when the close task shows the attached results.
verify: 1) Open the close task to confirm the attachment.
Pass when the results are attached and task marked complete.

steps.title: Confirm validation is complete before period lock
sop: 1) Review the close checklist for the matching control item.
2) Confirm the item shows complete before period lock.
Done when the matching control checklist item is marked complete.
verify: 1) Verify the checklist item status in BlackLine.
Pass when the item shows complete prior to lock.
